title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - ContractualPowerLimit
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/ContractualPowerLimit. The contractual power limit of a device Subclass of PowerLimit per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PowerLimit model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ContractualPowerLimit'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

hasContractualConsumptionMax.description: Property. The relationship between the contractual power limit and the value indicating the max limit consumption. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

hasContractualProductionMax.description: Property. The relationship between the contractual power limit and the value indicating the max limit production. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.
